verdict.rationale: Datalab documents converting PDFs, images and documents into Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks as machine-readable output, and says Marker handles complex layouts and tables. That covers the clean, LLM-ready output half of the story. Nothing in the pack mentions stripping repeated headers, footers, or page furniture. Community hands-on reports also note intermingled columns and messed-up tables in tricky layouts. Missing for 10: documented removal of repeated headers/footers and page furniture, explicit LLM-oriented output design, independent corroboration of clean output quality.
